summary: 非车应用的电池材料需求不能只用设备销量推导：同一应用中单机电量会随电压平台、续航、功率和轻量化要求变化，因此手机、工具、两轮车等都需要保存每台/每套电量强度的历史vintage。
why_search_may_miss_it: 行业通常保存终端销量或电芯GWh，跨年代单机电量的变化不容易被长期保留。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 formalized application segmentation and replacement cycles but not material intensity per device vintage
recalled_details.schema_implication: non-EV demand needs units × battery_energy_per_unit vintage

suggested_queries: 工具 电池 单机 电量 Wh 两轮车 电池 容量 变化
battery Wh per device power tool e-bike capacity trend
disconfirmation_queries: battery energy per unit is constant within each non-EV application

summary: 叉车、AGV、低速工业车辆等场景存在从铅酸向锂电迁移的独立周期，其经济性更多由高频使用、快充、维护和资产利用率决定，不应并入乘用车或固定式储能需求。
why_search_may_miss_it: 叉车/AGV需求散落在工业自动化和物流设备统计中，常被battery demand数据库归入other。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 covered e-bike lead-to-lithium policy but not industrial vehicle substitution economics
recalled_details.schema_implication: non-EV application taxonomy needs industrial_mobility and lead_acid_substitution state

suggested_queries: 锂电 叉车 铅酸 替代 AGV 电池 渗透率
lithium forklift lead acid replacement AGV battery adoption
disconfirmation_queries: industrial vehicle lithium demand follows passenger EV adoption mechanics

summary: 数据中心UPS和高可靠备电采用锂电的逻辑与通信基站不同：循环频率低但可靠性、占地、寿命与热安全要求高，铅酸替代速度取决于TCO和认证，而不是5G建设节奏。
why_search_may_miss_it: 通信备电与数据中心UPS常被合并成backup power，但采购方、认证、安全规范和需求驱动不同。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 preserved 5G telecom backup expectation but not data-center UPS as a separate demand mechanism
recalled_details.schema_implication: backup demand needs telecom vs datacenter application and reliability specification

suggested_queries: 数据中心 UPS 锂电 铅酸 替代 电池
data center UPS lithium battery lead acid replacement adoption
disconfirmation_queries: data-center UPS lithium adoption tracks telecom base-station procurement directly

summary: 18650/21700等圆柱电芯可同时服务工具、轻型动力、消费和部分汽车应用；当某一终端景气变化时，电芯厂可能在客户/应用间重新分配产能，因此按应用建立完全独立的圆柱产能池会重复计算可供给能力。
why_search_may_miss_it: 终端研究按应用拆分，制造端却可能共享相同圆柱产线和材料体系。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 covered independent tool/consumer inventory cycles but not cross-application shared cell capacity
recalled_details.schema_implication: cell capacity needs qualified_application_set and allocation vintage

cylindrical cell capacity allocation tools mobility 18650 21700
disconfirmation_queries: cylindrical cell capacity is permanently dedicated to one end application
disconfirmation_source_types: 分应用出货与产线认证

summary: 非车电池跨境销售常受UN38.3、航空/海运危险品规则以及终端安全认证约束，小型电芯即使电化学规格相近，也不能在不同国家和应用间立即切换供应。
why_search_may_miss_it: 行业产能统计按物理产线计算，但终端/地区认证和运输资质决定可销售市场。

lithium cell UN38.3 IEC 62133 certification market access

summary: 消费电子、AI终端、机器人或新型智能硬件的电池增量叙事容易把终端出货增长直接映射为锂电需求，但设备渗透、单机电量、产品寿命和是否真正采用可充锂电都需要分别验证。
